questions.question: Move group bookings earlier on the roadmap, from Q1 2027 to this autumn?
questions.body: The decision is Q1 2027, after deposits: [[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]], and [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]] kept it. Marcus says Nordic Steak needs it this autumn to sign.

frontmatter.summary: Group bookings is asked for a third time through sales, as a line in a contract, not as a problem a restaurant has had

input.body:
[[customers/nordic-steak]] wants group bookings in the contract before they sign. The request came through [[people/marcus-ek|Marcus]] as a contract line, not as a problem a restaurant has had. It is the third time, after June and the [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]], in the same form. The answer has not moved: group bookings waits on deposits, so Q1 2027 ([[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]]).

The same message asks for the Google button as if it were coming. [[tickets/jira/GST-77]] has been live since 2026-05-12, and sales was not told.

Marcus Ek, in #sales at 08:52 on 2026-07-17, wants an answer this week: "Their ops lead needs two things in the contract: group bookings with a set menu, and the Google "Book a table" button on every restaurant. Can I tell them both are coming this autumn? I NEED BOTH TO SIGN THEM."
input.rationale: A note of what was asked, so the next group bookings question from sales finds it instead of starting over.

input.append: - 2026-07-17: told through Marcus: the Google button, [[tickets/jira/GST-77]], is live now, switched on under Settings, Booking channels. Group bookings is Q1 2027, after deposits, per [[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]].
input.rationale: Nordic Steak was last told "on the roadmap", with no quarter. Today Marcus gets a date for the button and a quarter for group bookings, and this is what Oskar hears.

input.append: - 2026-07-17: the Google button, [[tickets/jira/GST-77]], has been live since 2026-05-12, so it goes in the Nordic Steak contract as done. Group bookings is Q1 2027 and the date is not open, per [[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]].
input.rationale: The reply to Marcus is drafted today. It gives him the date for the button and the quarter for group bookings, so his page says so.

variants.label: Short
variants.body:
Hey Marcus,

The Google button is a yes, and it is already live. It shipped on 2026-05-12 for every restaurant. Each restaurant switches it on under Settings, Booking channels. Put it in the contract as done.

Group bookings is a no for this autumn. It stays at Q1 2027.

The reason is the deposit. A party of twelve that books a set menu and does not turn up costs the restaurant the food as well as the table. Group bookings with no deposit gives Nordic Steak a bigger no-show problem, not a smaller one. Deposits are planned for Q4, and group bookings follows in Q1 2027.

So the contract can say Q1 2027 for group bookings. I can't give you a month yet.
